choice.basis: The dashboard's plotted production series (the only data encoding) starts at 3,500 in 2018 and ends at ~2,050 in 2023, establishing a net decrease over the 2018-2023 review period. The chart title's claim of 'Increasing Production' directly contradicts this visual evidence and is refuted as an authoritative override. The 'Route to production decline response' option directly corresponds to the observed net decrease.
